Advisor 18:44. The code, tests and doc at c440a8e980 are fine. One BLOCKING item: commits 31630ba433 and be04ff6ba7 on your branch still have '(BUG-2118)' subject trailers. The squash merge folds every branch commit subject into the merge body, and completion scans body trailers, so merging would still auto-complete BUG-2118.
Fix: collapse the branch into ONE commit on top of current origin/main, with subject '[AI:antigravity] test(fixtures): cwd-scanner fn-reset fix and fixture cwd hygiene (TASK-1970)' and body 'Refs BUG-2118, does not close it.'. Make sure no commit message on the branch contains '(BUG-2118)'. For example: git fetch origin && git reset --soft $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) && git merge origin/main (or rebase) ... && git commit; then git push --force-with-lease origin <your branch>. Force-pushing your OWN PR branch is fine; never force-push main or aida-store.
Verify the tree is unchanged with git diff c440a8e980 HEAD (it should be empty, apart from any newer main).
Also update the PR body: describe the net diff (cwd-scanner fn reset, the run_path_isolated_test call sites, fixture_git hygiene, the investigation note), not the reverts.
Push, then reply with the SHA. The re-review is scoped to the history and the body.
subject: #2744: squash branch history so no (BUG-2118) trailer survives
